baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5-6 name an expansive earth as the speaker's, while words 1 and 8 pair servant identity with the worship imperative.
baseline_models.mechanism: The whole terrestrial field belongs to one speaker, spatial breadth opens alternatives beyond any obstructive locale, and the repeated servant/worship root keeps allegiance invariant while place can change.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial lower expanse supplies the literal field whose first-person possession makes every location part of one domain.
Spatial opening supplies room beyond a constricted locale and makes movement thinkable.
The servant noun and worship command bind identity and action as humble obedience across the opened field.

changed_reading.before: The earth is geographically large, followed by a general command to worship.
changed_reading.after: No single locale exhausts the speaker's domain: place may change when it blocks obedience, but exclusive allegiance does not.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal transition from the assertion of breadth at word 6 to the exclusive imperative at words 7-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breadth can name usable capacity and practical relief from constriction, so the assertion does more than describe acreage: it answers whether the demanded worship remains feasible and permitted under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and bearable scope turn physical width into an assurance that obedient action remains within reach.
Practical easing supplies a license-like removal of hardship rather than a merely scenic description.
Submissive worship is the action for which the available room and relief are supplied.

changed_reading.before: Wide means that more land exists.
changed_reading.after: Wide also means that the command is furnished with usable capacity and released from the claim that one constricted setting is unavoidable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The addressees are characterized by the trust/belief root at word 3 before being told that the earth is expansive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief carries both heart-settling trust and assenting confirmation; placed before spatial release, it can make trust the inner condition that permits loosening dependence on one familiar place.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supply the affective stability needed when geography becomes unsettled.
Heart-confirmed belief keeps the address doctrinally anchored rather than reducing it to travel advice.
Opened space is the outward counterpart to inward trust.

changed_reading.before: Those who assent are informed of a large territory.
changed_reading.after: Those whose hearts entrust themselves are invited to release a constricting attachment to place without releasing faith.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first-person possessives join the servants at word 1 and the earth at word 5 to the same speaker.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ownership image in servant identity and the earth branch that can name a stranger shift belonging away from native soil; the honor branch keeps this claimed status from being only degradation.

activation_trace.role: Being claimed as a servant makes relational ownership portable across locations.
The honor side of the address allows claimed servanthood to carry dignity rather than mere subjection.
The stranger image exposes the social cost of movement while keeping that foreignness inside the speaker's earth.

changed_reading.before: Leaving native land makes a person an unclaimed outsider.
changed_reading.after: A servant may become locally foreign yet remain claimed and honored everywhere within the same speaker's earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first tests professed faith, then depicts harm that makes a person unable to settle, rescue by separation, and an explicit move from one abode to another toward the Lord. These cues turn the focus's breadth from abstract consolation into an actionable exit from coercive conditions.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies spatial room in which departure can occur.
Testing exposes whether voiced belief can survive a costly change in circumstances.
Injury that prevents settled rest supplies the pressure that can make remaining in place untenable.
Rescue pictured as release by separation supplies a precedent for safety through disengagement.
Movement from one abode to another toward the Lord gives the opened space an explicit directional enactment.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 puts the profession of belief under testing before any migration narrative appears.
29:24-26 moves in sequence from threatened burning, through rescue, to an explicit departure toward the Lord.
In 29:56 the result marker connects announced breadth directly to the exclusive worship command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tested belief, destabilizing harm, rescue by separation, and a move between abodes; I infer that obstructed worship is the condition under which breadth authorizes departure, while steadfast endurance in place remains a live alternative when worship is still possible.

changed_reading.before: The focus generally reassures pressured believers that other places exist.
changed_reading.after: The focus makes tested faith mobile: when coercive place and exclusive worship become incompatible, departure within God's domain can itself enact fidelity.

context_deltas.mechanism: False protective attachment is pictured as a structurally weak dwelling, whereas faithful actors are later given settled, elevated rooms. The focus between them makes movement across the broad earth a transfer of reliance and lodging, not simple homelessness.

activation_trace.role: The speaker-owned terrestrial field is the interim space across which shelter can be relinquished and re-situated.
The dwelling and refuge image makes misplaced protective allegiance materially house-like.
Loss of strength reveals that the apparent refuge cannot bear the protective load assigned to it.
Being installed in a prepared abode supplies a positive answer to the fear of displacement.
Elevated chambers replace the fragile local shelter with durable, raised lodging.

structural_cues: The weak-house image of 29:41 precedes the focus, while promised lodging in 29:58 follows it.
29:55 closes space vertically with punishment from above and below; 29:56 opens it horizontally before 29:58 supplies a new abode.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed refuge and later prepared lodging; I infer that leaving an obstructive shelter is a re-housing of allegiance rather than abandonment to placelessness, while the later rooms may remain solely eschatological rather than a promise of earthly housing.

changed_reading.before: Leaving a familiar place primarily means losing shelter.
changed_reading.after: The focus loosens dependence on a fragile protective house and places the traveler within a larger divine domain oriented toward prepared lodging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is denied to rival objects of worship, assigned by God, shown not to be self-carried by every creature, and expanded or restricted among servants. Patience and reliance connect this economy to movement, so earth's breadth includes livelihood capacity and not only destinations.

activation_trace.role: Breadth of means and livelihood lets the focus's spatial adjective carry an economic dimension.
Apportioned giving is detached from rival worship and attached to the one toward whom worship is directed.
Self-restraint under distress supplies the temporal discipline required before provision is visible.
Reliance supplies the relational posture that prevents livelihood uncertainty from freezing action.
The image of lifting and carrying an outward load exposes the assumption that a mover must transport a complete guarantee of sustenance.
Sustaining food is supplied to creatures and addressees, answering the practical fear beneath departure.
Expansion and increase make provision's breadth an active divine distribution rather than a fixed local resource.
Restriction to a narrow measure prevents the model from promising uniformly abundant outcomes.

structural_cues: 29:17 already joins worship and the ownership of provision.
29:56-62 runs from breadth, through death and promised lodging, to patience, reliance, non-carrying creatures, and expanded or restricted provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportioned sustenance, creatures that do not carry it, reliance, and expansion or restriction; I infer that these answer the livelihood fear latent in leaving a place, while they may instead teach reliance under any circumstance and do not guarantee prosperity after movement.

changed_reading.before: A wide earth offers possible destinations but the mover must first secure and carry livelihood independently.
changed_reading.after: The focus's breadth includes divinely apportioned means: obedience need not wait for total self-guarantee, though provision may still arrive in restricted measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A protected enclosure is physically secure while people around it are seized, yet the same verse uses the security/belief root for false allegiance. This distinguishes local safety from faithful trust and prevents the focus's wide earth from being misread as uniformly danger-free.

activation_trace.role: The addressees' settled trust supplies a portable form of security not identical with enclosure.
A bounded sanctuary supplies genuine but geographically concentrated protection.
The paired secure-place and believing uses expose the difference between physical safety and where trust is placed.
Rapid seizure outside the enclosure keeps real travel danger inside the model.
The surrounding zone draws the spatial boundary across which safety is uneven.

structural_cues: 29:67 contrasts a secure center with exposed surroundings, then immediately questions false belief.
The focus addresses believers through the same root before announcing a broad domain rather than a bounded sanctuary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real sanctuary security, exposed surroundings, and a contrast between belief and falsehood; I infer that faithful security is relational and portable rather than a promise that every place is physically safe, while the sanctuary remains a genuine divine gift and is not devalued.

changed_reading.before: Believers can move because all of God's wide earth should be equally safe.
changed_reading.after: The earth is usable despite uneven danger: secure enclosure can coexist with false allegiance, so trust and exclusive worship, not risk-free location, define the addressees' security.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah denies escape anywhere on earth, shows earth itself engulfing, and places universal death and return immediately after the focus. Breadth is therefore operational room for obedience before return, not unlimited flight from divine reach or mortality.

activation_trace.role: The broad terrestrial field supplies horizontal room, but remains the same earth named in the limits that follow.
Failure to outrun or elude pursuit blocks an escapist reading of spatial extent.
Earth sinking beneath people reverses ground from route of escape into an agent of enclosure.
Loss of life and power imposes the universal temporal boundary immediately after the command.
Return closes the trajectory: movement across earth ultimately bends back toward the speaker.

structural_cues: 29:55 surrounds the condemned from above and below, 29:56 opens horizontal breadth, and 29:57 closes mortal duration with death and return.
29:22 explicitly places inability to elude within earth and heaven.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed evasion, engulfing ground, vertical enclosure, death, and return; I infer that width grants room for timely obedience rather than escape from judgment, while 29:22 may address eschatological evasion specifically and need not limit ordinary migration.

changed_reading.before: A wide earth is an indefinite escape route away from threat.
changed_reading.after: A wide earth is bounded opportunity: move within it for worship while possible, because neither ground nor distance cancels death and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel in earth is commanded, routes can be cut or blocked, corruption and self-exaltation deform land use, creation is grounded in truth, and striving receives guided paths. The exclusive worship command gives broad mobility a moral direction rather than licensing aimless roaming or territorial mastery.

activation_trace.role: Wide stride and travel capacity make the adjective dynamically traversable rather than statically large.
Going and flowing through the land supplies an explicit practice of terrestrial movement.
A traversable road that can be cut shows that broad space depends on viable routes.
Departure from sound order places an ethical prohibition on how the broad earth is inhabited.
Self-magnifying domination in the earth supplies the rejected alternative to servant-like movement.
Stable truth gives created space a moral grain rather than treating it as neutral territory.
Gentle direction toward a way turns open spatial possibility into guided travel.
Plural traversable ways preserve multiple routes while keeping them oriented by guidance.

structural_cues: Commands to travel in 29:20 and not corrupt earth in 29:36 frame mobility as accountable practice.
Arrogance in earth at 29:39 contrasts with the servant address at 29:56.
The surah ends with striving, guidance, and plural paths, supplying an oriented endpoint to opened space.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traversal, obstructed roads, corrupt and arrogant land use, truth-grounded creation, and guided paths; I infer a tenant-like ethic under the possessive 'My,' while the plural paths may be primarily moral disciplines rather than literal migration routes.

changed_reading.before: The wide earth is neutral space available for relocation.
changed_reading.after: The wide earth is a morally structured domain to traverse as a servant: movement must avoid corruption and mastery and seek guided ways.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reverses a side branch of the earth root rather than translating the surface noun that way. It remains anchored in word 5, the explicit breadth at word 6, and the packet's move-between-abodes cue; render it as an exploratory psychological-material image, not as the lexical sense of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5 can carry a branch image of clinging or becoming heavy toward ground, directly opposed by the expansion at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Clinging and heaviness toward ground supply an internal mechanism by which one patch of a broad earth can become immobilizing.
Spatial opening supplies the reversal of self-produced narrowness.
Moving from one abode to another demonstrates the release of ground-bound attachment.

changed_reading.before: Narrowness is only an external shortage of available land.
changed_reading.after: Even a vast earth becomes functionally narrow when one clings to a single ground; the call may release psychic immobilization as well as physical confinement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is highly form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the breadth root, whose branch names an idol, and must not be presented as etymology or translation. It remains packet-valid because that target is attached to word 6 and the immediate command is exclusive worship amid repeated idol-worship context; render only as a contained sound-and-branch resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant target attached to word 6 places an idol-name branch immediately before the fronted exclusive object and worship command.

activation_trace.role: The idol-name side branch creates a remote anti-idol resonance at the threshold of exclusive worship.
An explicitly worshiped idol supplies the surah-level polemical environment that activates the remote branch.
Repeated worship acts divided between rivals and God make exclusivity, rather than mere spatial size, the functional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The adjective contributes only spatial vastness before the worship command.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, the sound-field of vastness brushes against a named idol only to be cut off by 'Me alone': no localized cult object can own the wide domain.

strongest_changes: Whole-surah testing, harm, rescue, and explicit migration turn spatial breadth into a practicable response when place obstructs worship.
Weak refuge before the focus and prepared lodging after it recast departure as re-housing allegiance rather than becoming placeless.
Provision, non-carrying creatures, patience, reliance, and measured expansion answer the livelihood fear latent in mobility without promising abundance.
The secure-sanctuary contrast and the immediate death/return sequence bound the reading: broad earth is neither uniformly safe nor an escape from divine reach.
summary.what_was_special: The focus acts as a hinge: vertical enclosure in 29:55 opens into horizontal breadth at 29:56, then closes into death and return before unfolding lodging, reliance, and provision. Repeated servant, belief/security, earth, route, and provision cues make one short command simultaneously spatial, relational, economic, and ethical without collapsing those readings.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the primary practical scope is literal migration from persecution or any release from conditions that obstruct worship.
How strongly capacity, livelihood, and stranger branches should color the dominant spatial sense of breadth and earth.
The non-dominant idol-name resonance is packet-resolvable but very form-distant and must remain explicitly exploratory.
